rv.q: Welcome to the worst show of the year so far... so inept that part of me suspects it must be part of some Reform UK psy-ops campaign to put political theatre out of business.
After the Act is a wonderful piece of documentary theatre that had a critically acclaimed national run before coming to the Theatre.
Silenced voices struggle to be heard in this moving but messy show.
Act is a soul-crushing but ultimately uplifting musical that balances the light with the serious and moves just as much as it entertains.
